blocks.title: Software development methodologies
blocks.text: Software development methodologies software banane ke munazzam tareeqe hain jo software projects ki planning, takhleeq aur intezam ki rehnumai karte hain. Yeh development ke amal ko nizaam-wari aur kaarkard banane aur aala maiyar ka software dene mein madad dete hain.
Is chapter mein Waterfall model, Agile methodology, Scrum, Lean software development aur DevOps parhe jate hain. Har ek kuch qism ke projects ke liye doosron se behtar hai.

blocks.prompt: Software development methodologies kis cheez ki rehnumai karti hain aur kya hasil karne mein madad deti hain?
blocks.explanation: Yeh software projects ki planning, takhleeq aur intezam ki rehnumai karti hain, aur amal ko nizaam-wari aur kaarkard aur product ko aala maiyar ka banane mein madad deti hain.

items: Methodologies: software projects ki planning, takhleeq aur intezam ke munazzam tareeqe.
Is chapter mein: Waterfall, Agile, Scrum, Lean, DevOps.
